title: Asthma Phenotypes in the Inner City
brief_summary: This is an epidemiologic, multi-center, cross-sectional study to define the phenotypic characteristics of Difficult-to-Treat asthma, among children between the ages of 6 to 17 years, receiving one year of guidelines-based therapy for asthma and rhinitis/rhinosinusitis.
study_population: Inner-city Asthma Consortium (ICAC) children with mild to severe asthma
